elements.label: Right sparkle accent

pattern.description: Last word 'business' rises and rotates into place from a faded state, the headline lockup settles slightly as it lands, then two sparkle accents pop in around the phrase.
pattern.why_premium: The final word lands on the narrated 'your business' and the lockup reacts to it physically; the delayed sparkle pops add a small reward beat after the type settles.

build_hint.gsap: tl.fromTo('.w-business', {yPercent: 60, rotation: 6, opacity: 0.3}, {yPercent: 0, rotation: 0, opacity: 1, duration: 0.25, ease: 'power3.out'}).to('.lockup', {y: '+=8', duration: 0.25, ease: 'power2.out'}, '<').fromTo('.sparkle', {scale: 0}, {scale: 1, duration: 0.2, ease: 'back.out(2.5)', stagger: 0.1}, '>-0.05')
build_hint.remotion: Word: spring({frame, fps, config: {damping: 22, stiffness: 220, mass: 0.8}}) mapped to translateY 60%->0, rotate 6deg->0, opacity 0.3->1; lockup translateY driven by the same spring; sparkles: spring({frame: frame - 8 - i*3, fps, config: {damping: 9, stiffness: 260}}) to scale 0->1 (overshoot).

notes: Burst starts mid-entrance; 'business' is already partly visible at f1262, so its start state is inferred. A lighter background band near the bottom also moves at f1262-f1263 (no candidate box; not listed). Sparkle pop may be a separate sub-beat.
